note_fields.submitted_at: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the technician submitted the note

appliance_type.definition: the appliance that was serviced on this visit

model_number.definition: the serviced unit's model number exactly as written (three letters, a hyphen, four digits, an optional letter); null when the note says it could not be read or found. Not a part or stock number

problem_category.definition: the customer's reported symptom. Use error_code only when an error code is the only thing reported

part_replaced.definition: the part actually installed on this visit; none if no part was installed (a part that was only ordered is none)

visit_date.definition: the date of the visit; all visits are in 2026; resolve relative dates against submitted_at

follow_up_needed.definition: true only when a return visit is scheduled or a part is on order; 'call us if it happens again' is false
